body:
Part of #3743. Builds on step 2 (#3752). Step 4 of the migration.

## What happens

Three more callers use the start-side planner or the Waterline planner directly:
- Do not touch, per level: `crates/motion/src/machining2d/pocket_avoid.rs:147-161` (ramps on at `:158`).
- The 2D Adaptive ring fallback: `pocket_hsm.rs:85-99`, `pocket_hsm_start.rs:94` (ramps off).
- The 3D Pocket levels: `crates/motion/src/machining3d/level_side.rs:51-60` (`level_ring_plan`, ramps off), and the 3D Adaptive fallback (`machining3d/hsm.rs:263`).

## Fix approach

1. Each of these callers takes its rings from `ring_set`, its links from `ring_links` and its entry from `ring_entry`.
2. Remove `ring_plan`, `ring_plan_ramped`, `level_ring_plan` and `side_plan` (`level_rings.rs:45-121`) when no caller is left.
3. Make the `StrategyFallback` area count true while the code moves (#3622).
4. Check #3616 (the 3D Pocket Adaptive fallback does not follow Pass starts at). If the shared planner fixes it, close it with this PR. Else comment why.

## Pins (equivalence)

- The CL moves of `crates/motion/tests/pocket3d_pass_start.rs`, `crates/app/tests/pocket3d_pass_start.rs`, `crates/app/tests/adaptive_pass_start.rs` and the Do not touch tests are the same as on the head before this change (golden `.cl` recorded on that head).
- The verifier verdicts and the gouge checks do not change.
- The #3622 pins of the fallback count.

Effort `max`: the 2D and 3D pocket levels move to the shared planner, under the safety floor. Priority P2: a consolidation with identical output.

Done means: `level_rings.rs` has no planner entry point left, each caller uses the shared modules, and the pins are green.
